## Historical audit: S0016

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v2_2/results/r1/fixed_h/H0/fixed_version_test/commons_92056365/trajectory.jsonl`. References below are JSONL lines in this file; all observations are unsplit.

| Aspect | Evidence and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Goal | The task requested a separate-mesh reconstruction of one indoor photograph, matching viewpoint, framing, materials and placement. The student's “Window dining room” is an **inferred scene interpretation**, not independent confirmation of the reference (lines 1, 3). |
| Initial construction | The program specifies multiple tables, chairs, booths, pendant lamps, plants and architectural elements. Furniture assets contain separately included parts; coordinates and opposing chair facings specify intended placement and pose, but do not verify physical connection or reference correspondence. It uses colored primitives and modeled seams rather than evident image textures; its monochrome compositor rests on the student's claim about the source (lines 3–4). |
| Camera and lighting | The code sets a 33 mm camera, three area emitters and Cycles settings. These are attempted settings, not evidence that framing, lighting or rendering matched the photograph (lines 3–5). |
| Validation and correction | Execution 1 failed after 391.64 seconds at `world.color`: the world was `None`; no image was returned (line 5). The next student request actually included that traceback (line 6). The revised program conditionally creates a world, simplifies floor seams, replaces Boolean lamp shades with custom meshes, and reduces samples; it retains the camera and lights (lines 8–9). This is an executed revision, not a verified fix. |
| Final result | Execution 2 timed out after approximately 29.76 seconds, with empty stdout/stderr and no image (line 10). The visible outcome is **technical interruption following an initial runtime failure**; visual or geometric correctness and ultimate submission are unknown. It was not an empty patch. |
| Input and exploration | No teacher detection, diagnosis, recommendation, receipt or adoption is visible. The traceback was runner feedback, not teacher instruction. The student independently produced and revised code; the two recorded student sessions report zero tool calls (lines 2, 7). No rendered-view inspection is evidenced. |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferably, runtime feedback can motivate explicit initialization and a less expensive construction, but a proposed optimization is not demonstrated to work until execution completes. Task-specific hypotheses—whether the dining-room interpretation, furniture connections, materials, poses, camera and lighting match the reference, and whether the revised scene would finish with more time—remain unresolved. The reference and rendered images are not visible in this audit; neither the scene name nor the student's monochrome claim is visual verification.
